I met her at a New Year’s party when Charley brought her. I knew about her since before Charley even started dating her. We didn’t talk much about his girlfriend until he noticed my phone wallpaper as we were waiting for the check. I wrote down a reminder to change that before meeting up with Charley yesterday, but I forgot about it. He asked me why I had that photo as my wallpaper. I was a little embarrassed and hesitated to speak for a few seconds. I just told Charley what I have already told him before, that I was a fan of her before they even started dating, but I respect their relationship and he doesn’t have anything to worry about. Charley never ridiculed me for not being good with women, but yesterday he told me that of course he doesn’t have to worry about me because a guy like me would never get a girl like her. I still haven’t gotten an apology from Charley.
